# Show notification (`notify`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Apps & scripts · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** no

Shows a Windows notification.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text | no | `AutoSettings` | Notification title. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `message` | text | yes |  | Notification text. Placeholders such as {{ user }} are replaced. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: notify
    message: "Gaming mode on: {{ app }}"
```

## Notes

Notifications respect Windows Do Not Disturb.
